results.content: # US consumer confidence falls in August as gas prices remain above $4 per gallon. Confidence index drops to 89.4 in August from 90.2 in July amid frustration after five years of elevated inflation. Americans’ confidence in the economy declined again this month as the ongoing conflict in Iran continued to push US gasoline prices above $4 per gallon. The Conference Board said on Tuesday that its consumer confidence index dipped to 89.4 in August from 90.2 in July. That was the lowest level in seven months but was essentially within the same lukewarm range it has been in since the beginning of the year.
